brief:
Israeli military bulldozers pressed ahead with demolition work in Khirbet al-Taban, a Palestinian community in the Yatta area of the southern West Bank, the Ma'an news agency reported. The machinery has been systematically destroying structures in the settlement as part of what Israeli authorities describe as enforcement operations in the territory.

Khirbet al-Taban, like dozens of other Palestinian communities across the West Bank, has faced repeated demolition campaigns. Residents have had homes and infrastructure razed, and the community has been subject to displacement pressure for years. The latest round of bulldozer activity signals a continuation of these operations targeting the area's Palestinian population.
title: Israeli bulldozers continue erasing Khirbet al-Taban in Yatta
